messages.author: 351fecd32bf80c08
messages.subject: adding text/values to gheatmap circle?
parts:
Hi there,

Is there a way to add values/text in a gheatmap circle around a tree ?

For instance, in the pasted plot below, I've added one gheatmap around the tree to annotate the geographical origin (using colors).
Instead of adding a new external circle with a new color for each date of isolation, I'm trying to either:

1) adding as text the date of isolation within each cell of the first circle
2) or if 1) is not possible, adding a new circle with no colours but text values (dates)

I've tried to play with the "colnames_level" option but without success....

Attached a draw/example of what I'm trying to do (I've just included three dates as an example but I'd like all cells to be filled).

Thanks for your help,
Adrien
